subject: design/e2e-verification-artifacts-v2
statement: the per-run bound the `cost-controls` slot states is denominated in **tokens and session count** — never money, never wall-clock. A money view is *derived* on demand by applying the repository's pinned per-model price map, never written into the frozen document. A dollar figure in an immutable doc goes stale the next time a price moves, and a wall-clock bound is non-hermetic — the same code passes on a fast machine and fails on a slow one, which is precisely the category error incident I5 charged this repository for. A token-and-session bound stays true as prices move and is countable while the run executes, so the `cost-controls` slot's "how it is enforced" half has something real to enforce against (`design-brainstorm:e2e-verification-tech-design-2#D-7`).
